entities.summary: Kristina A. Kvien is an American diplomat who had served as United States Ambassador to Armenia. She previously served as United States Chargé d’Affaires to Ukraine from May to June 2019 and from January 2020 to May 2022. From June 2019 to January 2020, she was Deputy Chief of Mission at the Embassy of the United States in Kyiv.
